tutorial.hintPerfect: PERFECT! Arrow points UP tap now to launch!
tutorial.hintWait: Wait for rotation until arrow points UPWARDS
tutorial.step1Text: Tapping swaps the anchor pivot between Cat and Bomb to build momentum.
tutorial.step2Text: Perfect timing is when the yellow arrow points upwards towards the gate!
tutorial.step1Desc: The Cat and Bomb continuously spin around each other on an elastic rope.
tutorial.step2Desc: When the swinging entity points UPWARDS, tap anywhere on screen to catapult forward!
tutorial.step3Desc: Pass cleanly through gate gaps and avoid sawblades or screen boundary walls!
